text:
alex: Quick follow-up from today's dedicated GPU pool sync. Proposal: soft-resize windows + decaying "grace credits" to reduce churn and make burst lanes predictable. Short summary + config sketch below.

mari: can you outline the lifecycle briefly?

alex: lifecycle: tenant requests burst -> if credits & headroom ok, admit to burst lane. If admission requires scale, create scale-intent with soft_resize_window (base 90s). During window: new nodes provision, eviction of those nodes is suppressed, grace credits charged. If demand falls before window ends, nodes are drained but not deleted until expiry.

jordan: suppressing eviction seems dangerous if cluster gets hot.

alex: we only suppress eviction for those provisioned for the intent window. Preemption still allowed. Also global governor blocks further admits when cumulative headroom > global_burst_headroom_pct (default 15%).

sam: make window adaptive?

alex: yes: adaptive_window = clamp(30s, 90s, p95_provision_latency*1.1).

lee: how do credits work with reservations?

alex: priority: reserved capacity > burst(grace credits) > best-effort. Credits split: micro (daily refill) + long (weekly allotment). Micro handles quick spikes, long covers planned bursts. Credits penalize repeated spikes with decay/penalty curve.

mari: fallback when provisioning fails?

alex: try variant routing (quantized model), then cross-region if allowed, then queue (202 + retry-after). If queue TTL expires return 503 and refund burst credit.

jordan: telemetry additions?

alex: metrics: burst_admit_count, grace_credit_balance{tenant}, consecutive_spike_count{tenant}, soft_resize_window_seconds, scale_pending_seconds, scale_latency_p95.

sam: quick operator config example?

alex: small YAML sketch: ```
apiVersion: redwood.io/v1
kind: PoolAutoscalePolicy
spec:
  baseSoftWindowSec: 90
  adaptiveMultiplierP95: 1.1
  graceCredits:
    microDaily: 40
    longWeekly: 200
    decayAlpha: 1.3
  globalBurstHeadroomPct: 15
  queueTTLsec: 300
```

lee: rollout plan?

alex: sim harness with replay traces (2w), staging canary (1w), pilot with 2 customers (3w), feature-flagged rollout with metric gates. I'll open a follow-up PR with sim plan and cost deltas.

mari: sounds good. ops-bot: link RFC update?

ops-bot: RFC updated -> https://redwood.rfc/internal/rgpu-softwindow-v1

jordan: thanks — this addresses a lot of oscillation concerns.

alex: cool, will file PR and ping reviewers.
